name: Canyonlands National Park
tagline: Canyonlands — Island in the Sky overlooks; one mesa, not all districts.

practical.transit_note: Moab; Island in the Sky is closest for most families.
practical.energy_note: Sun and exposure; no shade at many rails.
practical.best_start: Visitor center → Mesa Arch or Grand View area short stop
practical.season_note: Hot summers; combine carefully with Arches crowds.
